meta.title: Speech Reach
meta.framing: All speech analyzed here is already public. This tool measures legal and platform rules that affect how far it travels in X’s algorithmic feed.
meta.privacyCore: Individual account names and specific posts are never published on this page. Exact lists remain available in the original public sources. This ledger measures code-visible limits on the algorithmic distribution of already-public speech.
methodology: Primary source of truth for each entry is the public open-source filter in the xai-org/x-algorithm repository (and any official dataset the filter cites).
Account-scale counts come from the published code (for example, the Brazil filter’s own test asserts list size).
Outcome metrics use purposive public sampling of already-public posts — the same class of methods used elsewhere on Elenchos for topics and signals.
Metrics are system-level aggregates only. We do not publish handles, user IDs, or individual posts on this site.
Users who need the exact constrained list must open the original public GitHub source (and official TSE open data where cited).
limitations: Not a full map of content moderation, visibility filtering, or account-level enforcement.
Not a national opinion poll or election forecast.
Reach and volume figures are directional / approximate — not a complete census of the feed.
For You behavior can vary by viewer graph, locale, and product experiments; we report system-level patterns only.
Paid boosting exceptions noted in the legal/code comments are outside this v1 measurement window.
meta.futureNote: Speech Reach is designed to add further jurisdiction-specific recommendation constraints as they appear in the public code, using the same privacy-safe, system-level approach — no individual accounts or posts on public pages.

entries.title: Brazil 2026 Election Recommendation Filter
entries.whatItDoes: Official campaign accounts listed under Brazilian electoral rules are excluded from X’s For You recommendations unless the viewer already follows them. Profiles and content remain fully accessible to anyone.
entries.activationNote: Active in the public For You pipeline (Brazil2026ElectionFilter). Activation marker is approximate to the public announcement/code window.

sources.label: TSE open data — Candidatos 2026 (dataset cited in code)

entries.verifyLabel: Verify on GitHub — public filter source

metrics.volumeChangeNote: Sampled organic volume from the constrained set fell after activation vs a short pre-activation baseline (indexed; not a full census).
metrics.nonListedShareNote: Share of sampled candidacy discussion carried by non-listed / secondary voices in the current window.
metrics.nonFollowerNote: Share of engagement on constrained-set posts from non-followers (public sample). Higher = more remaining reach depends on non–For You paths.

spectrum.label: Left / progressive lists
spectrum.note: Aggregate only — party family buckets, not individuals

metrics.sampleWindow: Public purposive samples · pre-activation baseline vs current post-activation window
caveats: Not a ranking of countries or a censorship scoreboard.
Activation marker on the chart is approximate to the public announcement/code window.
Spectrum buckets are coarse aggregates for scannability — not official TSE party classifications.

observations.text: Official campaign messaging is more confined to existing follower bases in For You contexts, while profiles and posts remain fully accessible via follow, search, profile, and direct link.
Broader conversation in sampled public discourse about major candidacies is increasingly carried by non-listed accounts and ordinary users.
The recommendation restriction is applied at system level across the political spectrum for accounts in the code-visible list — not as a single-party rule.

The filter does not delete posts, suspend accounts, or remove content from the open web: it limits algorithmic distribution in For You for non-followers of listed accounts (and related retweet/quote/reply context as implemented in the public filter).

doesNot: Delete posts or hide profiles from the open web
Suspend or permanently remove accounts by itself
Block following, searching, or opening a profile directly
Publish or rank individual speakers on this page
